snippet.title: Sol Protocol | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
''Space is full of danger... and questionable decisions''

We are excited to unveil the newest project from Singular Perception as a part of Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025 - Sol Protocol! Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems. 

If you are interested in Alpha Testing the games with us, join our Discord to learn more! 
https://www.singularperception.com/solprotocol/discord

Wishlist Now: 
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/sol-protocol/10067260370018011/
